release_notes: Buyer Log 7.0.198 TEST: PLM sample status fixes (CP PLM Numune column, checklist, Priority). Orders past production (loading, shortage, in transit, customs, warehouse, awaiting retail transfer) or with any shipped quantity are always sample-approved ("Approved · Post-production"), whatever PLM shows. Fixed: "Customs & Port Operations" was not recognised as the customs stage. If a sample type has an approved request, later unapproved re-entries are ignored; an approved Sample Evaluation Status also counts. Stage order: Fit and S/Off are independent; S/Off approves Artwork; PPS (final) approves Fit, S/Off and Artwork. CP › PLM SYNC › PLM SAMPLES now offers Selected / Missing / In production / All (table filters are no longer applied implicitly). New editable Priority rule: PPS not approved within 21 days of Ex-factory. Opening CP refreshes stale (24h+) sample data for in-production orders in the background.
